text: .aee/revision-rounds.txt — Verifier Critic round counter; integer (0-indexed, starting absent/0); hard cap triggers escalation path when current count >= 3 before incrementing

.aee/verification-report.json — Verifier Critic output; JSON array of verdict objects (documentType, documentRef, issueType, location, description, sourceFile, lineRange, severity); empty array when all documents pass

.aee/verification-summary.md — Verifier Critic human-readable summary: counts by issue type/severity, errors table, and clean-document list; 'Escalated — max revision rounds (3) reached' heading used in hard-cap path

docs/components/payload_plaintext.md — Synthesizer component doc for aurora-portal; round 2 had 2 wrong-citation errors in export_report command string ('aurora-cli export' vs actual 'aurora-cli report --project'); individual file doc api.py.md had the correct text
